notes.problem: A primitive worker lit flat and a pack reading as timber cladding because its long side faces the camera.
notes.fix: Rotate the pack so its laminated end face banded in tens faces the camera raked by the low left key; light the worker by rim only.

notes.problem: Flat orange slatted crate on legs in a black void, shot from the side; the worker the most visible primitive.
notes.fix: Metal copper at roughness about 0.3, a low three-quarter on the striped end face with a hot specular line per lamination, the worker on the shadow side as a rim-lit silhouette.

notes.problem: The pack reads as a brown timber crate with a flat orange end face; the worker a mannequin.
notes.fix: Metallic copper raked by the low key across the striped end face, stripes across the visible end, the worker on the shadow side three-quarter back.

notes.problem: A small mannequin at a sawhorse table under a quarter of the frame, a mid-tone horizon band, a work light that does not pool on the table.
notes.fix: Eye 1.1 m dollied to about 4 m so the table and stack fill about 60% of the width, the work light's pool the only bright, the figure back three-quarter.

notes.problem: Table and figure about 20% of the frame, a mannequin, the work light two black boxes, a haze step at the horizon.
notes.fix: Camera in to about 3 m at eye 1.2 m so the table and stack fill the lower half, the figure cropped at the shoulders, the work light's pool the brightest value.

notes.problem: Table, figure and stack under a fifth of the frame in a dark bay; the official a mannequin.
notes.fix: Push in until the table and stack fill a third to half the width, light the stack as the brightest edge, the figure in profile in shadow.

notes.problem: A black reel silhouette cropped at the top right colliding with the dek.
notes.fix: Move the reel left and behind the far slab edge below the horizon, or rim it from the back right.

notes.problem: A blotchy mid-tone slab in the lower 60% and the reel crowding the dek.
notes.fix: A lower key so only the caps, bolt threads and casts are lit; the reel cropped by the frame edge.

notes.problem: An empty mid-tone slab in the lower half, a bolt cut at the footer, converging rows that can't be compared at thumb size.
notes.fix: A three-quarter view down two parallel rows across the lower two-thirds with the extra stubs past the shorter row; crop the empty slab and the footer bolt.

notes.problem: Four small packs in a black field read as a bar chart; Houston a sliver.
notes.fix: A 0.6 m eye moved in so West fills a third of the width, raking the lamination edges.

notes.problem: Exact ratios but crates in a bar chart over a dead dark ground.
notes.fix: A 0.5 m eye dollied in with the dunnage off the bottom edge and frame 3's metal copper.

notes.problem: Four packs read as wooden cabinets under floating labels, a brown bar chart.
notes.fix: Frame 3's copper, a 0.6 m eye raking every lamination edge, labels as tags on the dunnage.

notes.problem: A grey mid-tone field and an open stretch reading as a raised closed brown plate.
notes.fix: A visibly recessed ember channel with the curb casting into it, the caliche either side near black.

notes.problem: Mottled mid-grey caliche field and a flat dull brown open stretch; no bright edge.
notes.fix: Near-black caliche, the key raking only the trench, the open stretch in brand ember with its far wall lit.
